question.text: Rebalancing via INFLOWS (new deposits) rather than sales is tax-efficient because:

answer.text: It avoids triggering capital gains on overweight positions

explanation.text: The Logic: Using new cash to buy underweight positions defers capital gains vs selling overweight positions. The Trap: It's legitimate and recommended — not forbidden. Cross-Exam Context: Tax-aware PM. Manager's Pro-Tip: Coordinate monthly/quarterly inflows with portfolio drift — dynamic rebalancing cost-efficiently.
